points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in trustworthiness-critical workflows.
\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings and BM25 search, enhancing relevance and coverage of retrieved documents for clinical quality assurance.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring rigorous model evaluation and calibration.
\item Introduced batched query extraction using Python and SQL, reducing LLM calls by ~80% per query and enabling scalable automated quality assessment.
\item Designed an ML-based anomaly detection system for workflows, reducing redundant verification prompts by 25%, improving user confidence in model outputs.
\item Containerized and deployed scalable evaluation frameworks using Docker and AWS, ensuring robust pipelines for continuous model monitoring.
